description: Use this when the user gives a job posting link instead of its text; then pass the result to the job tools. Read a public job posting from its link and return the title, company, location and full description as plain text, ready for match_job, tailor_resume, keyword_scan or interview_questions. Reads LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Workday and most company careers pages. Some sites block reading; then ask the user to paste the text.
name: fetch_job_post
title: Fetch a job post
